stages.label: Registry rows Codex wrote
stages.note: Every row of the audit registry: findings, replays, equivalence results, rejections and duplicates.

stages.label: Finding rows taken into vetting
stages.note: Rows that carry a severity: 190 registry rows plus the 20 findings of the first run, parsed to 179 rows and 19 folded duplicates.

stages.label: Confirmed by Claude
stages.note: Checked against the code; Claude agreed with Codex's severity on 144 of 147. 3 were refuted.

stages.label: Fixed and verified
stages.note: 131 in the first fix wave and 9 platform fixes in the second; 3 deferred and 1 needed no change.

events.label: run 1 starts
events.text: Codex run 1 starts (gpt-5.6-sol, high effort): an adversarial parity audit of the non-macOS code, writing only to its own notes.

events.label: run 1 ends · 20 gaps
events.text: Run 1 ends with 20 verified gaps and a design for auditing every line.

events.label: run 2 starts
events.text: Run 2 starts at 8% of the weekly limit; its main thread runs gpt-5.5 at high effort and spawns the first independent reviewers.

events.label: “use medium effort”
events.text: The author: “use medium effort from now on”.

events.label: 100th round
events.text: The audit reaches its 100th round of reviewers.

events.label: 659-row registry
events.text: The findings registry is first reported at 659 rows.

events.label: last call · 99%
events.text: Last Codex call, at 99% of the weekly limit; Codex's own strict line ledger credits 10,929 lines (0.35%).

meterNote.text: From 00:00 to 03:59 UTC on 08-01 the hourly readings rise to 16%, then read 1–6% from 04:00. Run 1's own log goes from 0% to 6%, and run 2 began at 8%, so the higher readings are unexplained; the logs do not record why.
